status: local native Alchemy/workerd/R2 proof passed; optimization not deployed

baseline.behavior: A changed kernel identity reexecuted the Action and uploaded every prepared immutable block.

change: Read existing block bodies with bounded streaming SHA-256. Missing, truncated, oversized or digest-mismatched content is uploaded serially. Publish the manifest only after verification and repairs complete. Native R2 errors propagate. Reuse is not based on metadata, ETag or an assumed object key.

verification.runtime: Actual Alchemy dev Action and local R2 provider, native workerd and platform-proxy gateway; no mocked bucket
verification.providerMode: Objects created (local); fixture also checks native AlchemyContext.dev and dev_ stage
verification.unchangedVersions: Native R2 object versions sampled after cold publication are unchanged after warm publication; Damage verifies them before changing data.
verification.repair: One missing block, one same-length digest corruption and one oversized block are restored; all final body hashes, lengths and the published manifest are checked.

modeGuard.operation: alchemy plan with dev_ stage but non-dev execution mode

nativeConstraint.observed: Four concurrent cold reads failed with SQLITE_BUSY. Installed LocalR2Gateway opens a separate workerd against the same SQLite-backed bucket for each operation. Reads and writes therefore remain serial across both production and proof code.

limits: Local deployment evidence only; no production latency, CPU, billing or AgentOS cost comparison
A cold bucket now requires an existence read before each first upload
Warm verification still downloads existing bytes to preserve SHA-256 verification
Action memoization still applies; unchanged inputs do not rerun it automatically
Full parity and Rust/runtime performance gates remain open
